senses.gloss:
n. (-कं)
The milk of a prolific cow.

m. (-क्कः)
A young elephant.
E.
विक imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड.

m. (-कः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A bird.
E.
अज to go, वि substituted for the root, कन् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.

m. (-टः)
A plant, (Ruellia longifolia, &c.): see गोक्षुर.
E.
वि apart, ककि to go, aff. अटन्.

m. (-तः)
A small tree.
E.
वि apart, separate, ककि to go or grow, अतच् aff., or वि a bird, ककि, &c. as before; on which the birds roost.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
1 Blown, opened, expanded, spread, (as a flower, &c.)
2 Bald, having little or no hair on the head.
m. (-चः)
1 A Bauddha mendicant.
2 The planet KETU, or the personified descending node.
E.
वि apart, separate, कच to go, aff. अच्, or वि privative, and कच hair.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Large, great.
2 Formidable, frightful, hideous, horrible.
3 Large-toothed.
4 Beautiful, pleasing.
5 Changed in form or appearance.
6 Obscure, obsolete.
n. (-टं)
A bile, a tumour.
f. (-टा)
A female divinity peculiar to the Bauddhas.
E.
वि implying separation or expansion, कट to go or be, aff. अच्, or with कटच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A herbaceous plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
वि expanding, कण्ट a thorn, कन् added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Speaking idly.
2 Praising ironically.
3 Vaunting, boastful.
n. (-नं)
1 Irony, ironical or unmerited praise.
2 Praise in general.
3 Assigning any thing to an unreal origin.
4 Boasting.
5 Repeating, proclaiming.
E.
वि implying difference or extension, and कत्थन praising.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be praised, commendable.
2 Ridiculous, to be praised ironically.
E.
वि before कत्थ to praise, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-त्था)
1 Praise.
2 Irony, ironical praise.
3 Boasting.
4 Repeating, proclaiming.
E.
वि, कत्थ to praise, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-त्थी-त्थिनी-त्थि)
Who or what boasts, praises, proclaims, &c.: see विकथन.
E.
वि, कत्य to boast, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-म्पः-म्पा-म्पं)
1 Trembling.
2 Heaving.
3 Unsteady, not firm or continued..
4 Shrinking form.
E.
वि, and कम्प trembling.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Trembling, tremulous, agitated.
2 Palpitating, heaving.
3 Broken, interrupted, unsteady.
4 Shrinking from.
E.
वि before कपि to tremble, aff. क्त.

m. (-रः)
Sickness, disease.
E.
वि implying difference, and कर making.

m. (-रः)
1 Change of form or nature, alteration or deviation from the natural state.
2 Sickness, disease change from the state of health.
3 Passion, feeling, emotion, transition from the natural or quiescent condition of the soul.
E.
वि implying alteration, कृ to make, aff. अण्

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Formidable, frightful.
E.
वि intensitive, and कराल frightful.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Ear-less.
m. (-र्णं)
One of the KURU princes.
E.
वि, and कर्ण an ear, or a proper name.

m. (-कः)
Sārasvata, a district in the north-west of Hindustan, generally considered as part of the Punjab, though sometimes confounded with Kashmir.
E.
वि privative, and कर्ण KARṆA; aff. ठक्; the region from which KARṆA was proscribed.

m. (-नः)
1 The sun.
2 A son who has usurped his father's kingdom.
E.
वि before कृत to cut, aff. ल्युट्; having been shorn of some of his beams, by VIŚVAKARMA.

mfn. (-कृत्)
1 Acting illegally, one who does forbidden acts.
2 Busy in various ways.
E.
विकर्म्म, and कृत् who does.

f. (-या)
Illegal or immoral act.
E.
विकर्म्म, and क्रिया act.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Various business or duty.
2 Prohibited or unlawful act.
3 Fraud.
E.
वि, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Doing what is illegal or immoral, engaged in prohibited acts.
2 Engaged in various business.
E.
विकर्म्म, and स्थ who or what stays.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Doing forbidden acts.
2 Transacting various affairs.
m. (-कः)
Clerk or superintendant of markets or fairs.
E.
वि implying variety, कर्म्म business, and ठक् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Pulling, pulling apart or out.
2 An arrow.
E.
वि separate, कृष to attract, अच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Pulling, drawing, dragging.
E.
वि before कृष to attract, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Confused, confounded, agitated.
2 Defective, imperfect.
3 Decayed, impaired, withered, waned.
f. (-ला-ली)
A woman in whom menstruation has ceased.
n. (-लं)
The 1/60th of a Kalā, the second of a degree.
E.
वि privative, and कला a digit of the moon, &c.

m. (-लः)
Twilight.
E.
वि implying prohibition, (of peculiar ceremonies,) and काल time.

m. (-कः)
A cripple with a crooked or withered arm.
E.
विकल defective, पाणि the hand, and कन् added.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Deformed, crippled, maimed.
E.
विकल defective, अङ्ग the body.

n. (-णं)
1 Spoiling, breaking, maiming.
2 Confusing, agitating.
E.
विकल, and करण making, च्चि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Broken, injured, impaired.
2 Sick, lame, maimed.
3 Confused, distressed.
E.
विकल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Agitated, distressed.
2 Maimed, defective.
E.
विकल, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Having any of the organs of sense impaired or defective.
E.
विकल, and इन्द्रिय an organ.

m. (-ल्पः)
1 Error, ignorance, mistake.
2 Alternative, option.
3 Doubt, indecision.
4 (In rhetoric,) Antithesis of opposites.
5 (In grammar, &c.,) Admission of more than one form or rule.
E.
वि distinction, and कल्प making, &c.

mfn. (यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Doubting, deliberating, weighing alternatives.
E.
वि before कृप to be able, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made or acknowledged as optional.
E.
वि before कृप to be able, क्त aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Opening, expanding.
E.
वि separately, कश to go, वरच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Opening, expanding.
E.
वि before कष to go, aff. वरच्; also विकस्वर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Opening, expanding.
E.
वि apart, कस to go, aff. वरच्; also derived from कश or कष, विकश्यर, and विकष्वर.

f. (-षा)
Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.)
E.
वि before कष to injure, अच् aff.; also विकसा.

m. (-सः)
The moon.
f. (-सा)
Bengal madder.
E.
वि before कस to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-शः)
1 Solitude, loneliness, privacy.
2 Display, manifestation, open or splendid appearance.
3 Opening, expanding.
4 Budding, blowing, (as a flower.)
5 Pleasure, enjoyment.
6 Ether, heaven.
E.
वि before काश to shine, aff. घञ्; the vowel of the prefix is more usually made long: see विकाश.

m. (-शः)
1 Solitude, privacy.
2 Display, manifestation.
E.
वि before काश to shine, aff. अच्, and the vowel of the prefix long, by special rule.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
1 Opening, expanding.
2 Budding, blowing.
E.
वि before कस to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Blown, as a flower, budded, opened, expanded.
E.
वि apart, कस to go, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Changed, converted, made to undergo a changing.
2 Rendered unfavourable or unfriendly.
E.
वि before कृ to make, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Producing a change.
2 Undergoing a change.
E.
वि before कृ to make, णिनि aff., or विकार, and इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
Evening, twilight.
f. (-लिका)
A perforated copper vessel, which is placed in a pan of water, and being filled at the expiration of a certain period, defines that period: a sort of Clepsydra, or water clock.
E.
वि before काल time, and कन् added, or वि before कल to go, aff. क्वुन्.

f. (-ता)
1 Appearance, display.
2 Loneliness.
3 Expansion.
E.
विकाश shining, aff. तल्; also with त्व, विकाशत्वं.

n. (-नं)
1 Expansion, extent.
2 Manifestation.
3 Blowing, (of a flower.)
E.
विकाश, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-भृत्)
1 Expanding, being full.
2 Blown, budded.
E.
विकाश, and भृत् who or what has.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Expanding, spreading.
E.
वि before कश to go, aff. घिनुण्.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Expanding, &c.
E.
वि before कष to go, aff. घिनुण्.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Expanding, opening, budding, blowing.
E.
वि before कस to go, aff. घिनुण्; also with कश or कष the same, विकाशिन्, and विकाषिन् as above.

m. (-रः)
1 A bird in general.
2 A well.
3 A fallen fragment, a scattered portion.
4 Scattering.
E.
वि apart, &c., कॄ to scatter, क aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Throwing, scattering, sprinkling.
E.
वि before कॄ to scatter, शतृ aff.

n. (-णं)
Scattering, spreading about or abroad.
m. (-णः)
Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.)
E.
वि before कॄ to scatter, aff. यु.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Scattered, spread about, extended, diffused.
2 Celebrated, famous.
E.
वि implying extension, कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.

ind.
Having or being scattered.
E.
वि, and कॄ to scatter, aff. ल्यप्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being tossed, agitated, scattered, &c.
E.
वि before कॄ to scatter, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Joyful, cheerful, happy.
2 Undergoing or making a change of form, &c.
E.
वि before कृ to make or do, चानश or शानच् aff.

m. (-स्रः)
The moon.
E.
वि before कस to shine, रक् Uṇādi aff., and उ substituted for the radical vowel.

n. (-नं)
A side glance, a leer, a wink.
E.
वि before कूण to contract or close, (the eyes,) aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-का)
The nose.
E.
वि before कूण to sound, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Entertaining the feeling of disgust, averse, estranged.
2 Sick, diseased.
3 Altered, changed, either in form or feeling.
4 Imperfect, unfinished, incomplete.
5 Overcome by feeling or passion.
n. (-तं)
Disgust, aversion.
E.
वि implying reverse, and कृत made.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having the face distorted.
E.
विकृत, and वदन face.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Changed in aspect, form, or appearance.
E.
विकृत, and आकार form; also विकृताकृति.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Distorted, deformed.
E.
विकृत, and अङ्ग the limbs.

f. (-तिः-ती)
1 Change of any kind, as of purpose, mind. form, nature, &c. either permanent or temporary.
2 Sickness, disease, change from the natural or healthy state.
3 Fear, apprehension.
4 Spirituous liquor.
5 A species of metre: the stanza consists of four lines of two syllables each, variously arranged.
E.
वि implying alteration or reverse, कृ to make, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Pulled, drawn, (as a bow-string.)
2 Attracted.
3 Dragged, drawn, in general.
4 Sounded, making a noise.
E.
वि before कृष to draw, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Bald.
f. (-शी)
1 A small braid or tress of hair, first tied up severally, and then collected into the Veṇī or larger braid.
2 A woman without hair.
E.
वि severally or privative, and केश hair.

f. (-का)
A pledget, a piece of rag smeared with ghee or other substances and applied as a dressing to a sore.

m. (-षः-षा-षं)
Uncovered, denuded, unsheathed.
E.
वि privative, and कोष a sheath, a cover.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Incurious, indifferent.
E.
वि, and कौतुक curious.

m. (-मः)
1 Heroism, prowess, heroic valour.
2 Great power or strength.
3 Walking, going, proceeding.
4 Overpowering, overcoming.
5 Strength in general.
6 The name of a sovereign of Ougein: see विक्रमादित्य.
E.
वि before क्रम to go, to move, to walk, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Going, proceeding.
2 Overpowering.
E.
वि before क्रम to go, शानच् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
The name of a celebrated prince, the sovereign of Ougein, and reputed founder of an æra still in use amongst the Hindus, commencing 56 years before the Christian æra; there are however many princes of this name, and it has been applied to Rāja BHOJA, to ŚĀLIVĀHANA, and PṚTHVĪ Rāja, as well as to five or six others; the name also occurs variously written, as VIKRAMA, ĀDITYA, VIKRAMASENA, VIKRAMASIṂHA, VIKRAMĀRKA, &c.
E.
विक्रम power, and आदित्य the sun.

m. (-र्कः)
A name of the sovereign VIKRAMĀDITYA: see the last.
E.
विक्रम heroism, and अर्क the sun.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Conquered, acquired by valour.
E.
विक्रम, and अर्ज्जित gained.

m. (-मी)
1 A lion.
2 A hero.
E.
विक्रम strength, valour, इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
Sale, selling, vending.
E.
वि before क्री to buy, अच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Rescission of sale.
E.
विक्रय, and अनुशय doubt.

n. (-णं)
Selling, vending.
E.
वि reverse, क्री to buy, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-कः)
A vender, a dealer, a salesman.
E.
विक्रय sale, ठन् aff.

m. (-यी)
A seller, a vender.
E.
विक्रय sale, इनि aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Valiant, mighty.
2 Overcoming, victorious.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A hero, a warrior.
2 A lion.
n. (-न्तं)
Valour.
E.
वि before क्रम to go, aff. क्त, in an active sense.

m. (-न्तिः)
1 A horse's canter or gallop.
2 Prowess, heroic strength and valour.
3 Great power or strength.
E.
वि before क्रम to go, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
1 Valiant.
2 Victorious.
m. (-न्ता)
A hero, a victor.
E.
वि before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A vender, a seller.
E.
वि before क्री to buy, खुल् aff.

f. (-या)
Change of mind, form, purpose, condition, &c.
E.
वि implying reverse, and क्रिया action; see विकार.

ind.
Having sold.
E.
वि before क्री to buy, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sold.
E.
वि before क्री to buy, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Harsh, rugged, or unkind, (as speech.)
2 Called out, exclaimed.
n. (-ष्टं)
1 A cry of alarm or for help.
2 Abuse.
E.
वि before क्रुश to call, aff. क्त.

m. (-ता)
A vender, a seller.
E.
वि before क्री to buy, aff. तृच्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Vendible, saleable.
E.
वि before क्री to buy, aff. यत्.

n. (-नं)
1 Abusing, reviling.
2 Calling out.
E.
वि before क्रश to curse, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
1 Who reviles, abuses, speaks harshly, &c.
2 Who calls or cries out.
E.
वि before क्रुश to cry, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Overcome with fear or agitation, confused, confounded, lost, bewildered.
E.
वि before क्लु to go, aff. अच्.

f. (-ता)
Timidity, fear.
E.
विक्लव, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विक्लवत्वं.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Old.
2 Withered, shrivelled, decayed.
3 Wet, moist.
E.
वि before क्लिद to moisten, aff. क्त.

adv. n. (-णं)
Momentarily, for a moment.
E.
वि, and क्षण a moment.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Sight, seeing.
E.
वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Struck, hurt, wounded.
E.
वि before क्षत broken, torn.

m. (-वः)
1 Cough.
2 Sound.
E.
वि before क्षु to sound, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्)
1 Throwing, tossing.
2 Agitating.
E.
वि before क्षिप to throw, and शतृ aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Scattered, dispersed.
2 Thrown, cast.
3 Agitated, bewildered, perplexed.
4 Sent, dispatched.
5 Refuted, falsified.
E.
वि severally, and क्षिप्त thrown or sent.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Wasted, destroyed.
E.
वि before क्षै to decay, क्त aff.

m. (-कः)
1 The chief of a class of demigods, enumerated amongst those attached to ŚIVA, and the ministers of destruction amongst men by plague, pestilence, &c.
2 A meeting or assembly of the gods.
3 A place prohibited to eaters of meat.
E.
वि before क्षीण wasted, (by whom,) and कन् added.

m. (-पः)
1 Casting, throwing, or throwing away.
2 Sending, dispatching.
3 Confusion, perplexity, fear proceeding from ignorance or error.
4 Looking about vaguely or wildly, as of a woman for her absent lover.
5 Refuting an argument, establishing its falsehood.
6 Celestial latitude.
E.
वि before क्षिप to throw, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Scattering, dispersing.
2 Sending, dispatching.
3 Throwing.
E.
वि before क्षिप् to throw, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-वः)
(In astronomy), The greatest inclination of a planet's orbit.
E.
विक्षेप, and ध्रुव are.

n. (-भं)
1 Agitating, shaking.
2 Conflict, struggle.
3 Fearing.
E.
वि before क्षभ to stir, and घञ् aff.

mf. (-क्षः-क्षा)
Sight, seeing.
n. (-क्षं)
1 Surprise, astonishment.
2 A visible object.
E.
वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. क.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Visible, perceptible.
E.
वीक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Seeing, looking at.
E.
वि before ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Astonished, surprised.
E.
वीक्ष sight, आपन्न disturbed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seen, beheld.
n. (-तं)
A look, a glance.
E.
वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
1 Visible, perceptible.
2 Astonishing, wonderful.
ind.
Having seen.
n. (-क्ष्यं)
1 Wonder, surprise.
2 A visible object.
m. (-क्ष्यः)
1 A dancer, an actor.
2 A horse.
E.
वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. यत् or ल्यप्.
